class.name: ProbeVolume
class.brief_description: Adaptive irradiance probe volume with L2 SH probes, temporal updates and budgeted cell streaming.
class.description: [method build] places probe bricks of [member base_spacing], subdivided up to [constant MAX_LEVEL] times where the density callable asks for it. [method bake] and [method temporal_update] trace rays through a user supplied callable [code]func(origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3) -> Dictionary[/code] returning [code]{hit: bool, color: Color, distance: float, backface: bool (optional)}[/code]. Probes inside geometry are marked invalid and ignored when [method sample] interpolates trilinearly with backface weighting. Probes are grouped into streaming cells of [constant CELL_SPAN] bricks that can be serialized, unloaded and evicted under [member memory_budget_bytes]. The approach follows Majercik et al., "Dynamic Diffuse Global Illumination with Ray-Traced Irradiance Fields" (JCGT 2019) and Unity Adaptive Probe Volumes (concepts only).

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all probes.

method.name: probe_count
method.description: Returns the number of probes.

method.name: probe_position
method.description: Returns the position of a probe.

method.name: probe_sh
method.description: Returns the SH of a probe, or an empty array when its cell is unloaded.

method.name: is_probe_valid
method.description: Returns [code]false[/code] for probes inside geometry.

method.name: find_probe
method.description: Returns the index of the probe at [param pos], or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: sky
method.description: Returns the sky radiance in direction [param dir].

method.name: cell_of_position
method.description: Returns the streaming cell containing [param pos].

method.name: build
method.description: Builds bricks over [param bounds]. [param density_at] ([code]func(center: Vector3) -> float[/code] in [code]0..1[/code]) picks the subdivision level. Returns the probe count.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes every probe by tracing [param rays_per_probe] rays (at least 4) with a per-probe rotated Fibonacci sphere.

method.name: temporal_update
method.description: Updates a rotating subset ([param fraction] of all probes) of resident probes and blends with the old value using [member hysteresis]. Returns the number of probes updated.

method.name: sample
method.description: Returns irradiance divided by pi at [param pos] for a surface [param normal], interpolated from the 8 corner probes of the containing leaf. Falls back to ambient sky light outside the volume or when no probe is usable. Touches the sampled cell for LRU purposes.

method.name: touch_cell
method.description: Marks [param cell] as most recently used.

method.name: is_cell_resident
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the cell's probe data is in memory.

method.name: cell_probe_ids
method.description: Returns the probe indices of a cell.

method.name: resident_bytes
method.description: Returns the serialized size of all resident cells.

method.name: cells_needed
method.description: Returns the cells intersecting the sphere ([param view_pos], [param radius]), nearest first.

method.name: serialize_cell
method.description: Serializes a cell ([code]s32 count[/code], then per probe [code]s32 index, u8 valid, 27 float32[/code]). For an unloaded cell the stored bytes are returned.

method.name: load_cell
method.description: Restores a serialized cell, marks it resident and enforces the budget. Returns [code]false[/code] on malformed data.

method.name: unload_cell
method.description: Serializes, stores and frees a cell's probe data. Returns the bytes.

method.name: request_cell
method.description: Streams an evicted cell back in from the internal store. Returns [code]false[/code] if it is unknown.

method.name: enforce_budget
method.description: Evicts least-recently-used cells until [method resident_bytes] fits [member memory_budget_bytes]. The [param protect] cell and the most recently used cell are kept. Returns the number of evictions.
